text:
Companion Animal travel checks are required for every journey with Aurelia Skyways.

Travelers with a reptile must meet the minimum travel age of 11 weeks; this means the youngest age allowed for travel by a reptile. Please keep the animal ready for inspection at boarding so we can confirm documents and condition without delay.

For crate compliance, a cat must fit within the maximum crate dimension of 61 cm; this is the longest allowed side of the carrier. Use sturdy, well-ventilated carriers and secure the door firmly before arriving at the gate.

If you are unsure about sizing or paperwork, visit the Companion Animal Travel Desk for direct guidance before you travel.
